description: Source code for MacNodeBrowserProxy actor, which handles network requests to a local server for browsing and file operations related to node management in a macOS environment within the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: MacNodeBrowserProxy
classes.description: An actor responsible for managing network communication with a local node browser service, including requesting file listings and handling file uploads.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a network request based on provided JSON parameters and returns the response as a JSON string.

methods.name: defaultEndpoint
methods.description: Provides default configuration for the endpoint to connect to the local node browser service.

methods.name: decodeRequestParams
methods.description: Decodes JSON-formatted request parameters into a RequestParams object.

methods.name: makeRequest
methods.description: Constructs a URLRequest from request parameters and endpoint information.

methods.name: requireHTTPResponse
methods.description: Validates that a URLResponse is an HTTP response and casts it accordingly.

methods.name: httpErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a human-readable error message from an HTTP response and data.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Converts various data types to their string representations for query parameters.

methods.name: loadProxyFiles
methods.description: Loads and encodes files referenced in the response payload for proxy purposes.

methods.name: collectProxyPaths
methods.description: Recursively collects file paths from response data to load associated files.

methods.name: loadProxyFile
methods.description: Loads a single file from disk, encoding it in base64, and determining its MIME type.
